cards.quote: Complexity is O(n^2) for arbitrary data, but approaches Θ(n) if the list is nearly in order at the beginning.
cards.stem: What is the complexity when the input data is arbitrary?

cards.quote: but approaches Θ(n) if the list is nearly in order at the beginning.
cards.stem: How does the effort change if the list starts nearly in order?

cards.quote: Also known as sinking sort, exchange sort.
cards.stem: Which other name is used for this sorting method?

cards.quote: Sort by comparing each adjacent pair of items in a list in turn, swapping the items if necessary
cards.stem: What is compared on each pass through the list?
